name: FA_REVALUATIONS
description: FA_REVALUATIONS stores revaluation transaction related information at asset level.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset revaluation transaction.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset number on which the revaluation transaction is performed.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Asset book identification name.

columns.name: MASS_REVAL_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the mass revaluation transaction.

columns.name: REVAL_METHOD
columns.description: Stores the method used for revaluation.

columns.name: REVAL_FULLY_RSVD_FLAG
columns.description: Allows fully reserved asset revaluation.

columns.name: LIFE_EXTENSION_FACTOR
columns.description: Value of the life extension factor used when revaluing fully reserved assets using life-based methods.

columns.name: LIFE_EXTENSION_CEILING
columns.description: Value of the life extension ceiling used when revaluing fully reserved assets using life-based methods.

columns.name: REVAL_VALUE_TYPE
columns.description: Stores the value type used for revaluation.

columns.name: REVAL_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Revaluation percentage value used for the revaluation.

columns.name: REVAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Revaluation amount value used for the revaluation.

columns.name: FAIR_MARKET_VALUE
columns.description: Fair value of the asset after revaluation.

columns.name: MAX_FULLY_RSVD_REVALS
columns.description: Default value of the maximum number of revaluations allowed on a fully reserved asset.

columns.name: LINKED_FLAG
columns.description: Allows revaluation to be linked to prior impairment transactions.

columns.name: REVAL_GAIN_LOSS
columns.description: Stores the revaluation gain or loss amounts.

columns.name: ALLOW_FUND_ACCOUNTING_FLAG
columns.description: Enables fund accounting in the book.

columns.name: AMORTIZE_REVAL_RESERVE_FLAG
columns.description: Book-level option at the time of the revaluation transaction indicating whether revaluation reserve amortization is allowed.

columns.name: REVAL_DEPRN_RESERVE_FLAG
columns.description: Book-level option at the time of the revaluation transaction indicating whether depreciation reserve can be revalued.

columns.name: REVAL_YTD_DEPRN_FLAG
columns.description: Book-level option at the time of the revaluation transaction indicating whether year-to-date depreciation reserve can be revalued.

columns.name: PERIOD_END_REVAL_FLAG
columns.description: Include current period depreciation in revaluation calculations.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PRICE_INDEX_ID
columns.description: Stores the identifier of the price index used during index-based revaluation.

columns.name: PRICE_INDEX_VALUE
columns.description: Stores the value of the price index used during index-based revaluation.

columns.name: PRIOR_COST
columns.description: Cost of an asset before  revaluation.

columns.name: COST
columns.description: Cost of an asset after revaluation.

columns.name: PRIOR_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Depreciation reserve of an asset before revaluation.

columns.name: DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Depreciation reserve of an asset after revaluation.

columns.name: PRIOR_BONUS_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Bonus depreciation reserve of an asset before revaluation.

columns.name: BONUS_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Bonus depreciation reserve of an asset after revaluation.

columns.name: PRIOR_REVAL_RESERVE
columns.description: Revaluation reserve of an asset before revaluation.

columns.name: REVAL_RESERVE
columns.description: Revaluation reserve of an asset after revaluation.

columns.name: PRIOR_FAIR_MARKET_VALUE
columns.description: Fair value of an asset before revaluation.

columns.name: PRIOR_IMPAIRMENT_RESERVE
columns.description: Impairment reserve of an asset before revaluation.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_RESERVE
columns.description: Impairment reserve of an asset prior to revaluation.

columns.name: PRIOR_IMPAIR_LOSS_BALANCE
columns.description: Impairment loss of an asset before revaluation.

columns.name: IMPAIR_LOSS_BALANCE
columns.description: Impairment loss of an asset after revaluation.

columns.name: PRIOR_REVAL_LOSS_BALANCE
columns.description: Revaluation loss of an asset before revaluation.

columns.name: REVAL_LOSS_BALANCE
columns.description: Revaluation loss of an asset after revaluation.

columns.name: PRIOR_REVAL_AMORT_BASIS
columns.description: Revaluation amortization basis of an asset before revaluation.

columns.name: REVAL_AMORTIZATION_BASIS
columns.description: Revaluation amortization basis of an asset after revaluation.

columns.name: PRIOR_LIFE_IN_MONTHS
columns.description: Life of an asset in months before revaluation.

columns.name: LIFE_IN_MONTHS
columns.description: Life of an asset in months after revaluation.

columns.name: UPDATE_LAST_USED_INDEX_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies whether the value of the last used price index will be updated to a new value as of the revaluation date.

columns.name: BACKLOG_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Life-to-date backlog depreciation amount.

columns.name: REVALUED_COST
columns.description: Increase or decrease in cost due to revaluation of the asset.  Can be a positive or negative amount.

columns.name: REVAL_AMORT_BALANCE
columns.description: Accumulated revaluation amortization.

columns.name: PRIOR_BACKLOG_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Life-to-date backlog depreciation amount before the transaction.

columns.name: PRIOR_REVALUED_COST
columns.description: Life-to-date revalued cost amount before the transaction.

columns.name: PRIOR_REVAL_AMORT_BALANCE
columns.description: Accumulated revaluation amortization amount before the transaction.
